Partners work overnight at the izakaya in exchange for a percentage of daily revenue. They can work as a Chef, a Waiter or a Barmaid, where they cook [[Dishes]], deliver [[Dishes]], or deliver [[Drinks]] respectively (excluding [[Customers|Rare Customers]]). Some partners can have special effects that offer positive bonuses to the izakaya.
